purpose: Exercise the existing Araneae/MAVRIC review path against three public, non-sensitive targets before Academy-wide expansion.

targets.expectedEvidence: Metadata, structural observations, safe behavioral findings, and digests only.
Metadata, structural observations, safe behavioral findings, and digests only.
Validator result metadata and sanitized mismatch descriptions. Never include protected answer bodies.

correlationRules: Deduplicate observations that identify the same target, category, and underlying condition.
Keep code/runtime findings distinct from curriculum/pedagogy findings.
Do not infer a protected answer or learner record from metadata.
A validator PASS is evidence about the validator contract only, not automatic course certification.
A spyder recommendation never authorizes a repository change.
Conflicting observations are retained and escalated for human review rather than silently reconciled.
successCriteria: All emitted observations conform to the admin-safe observation fields.
No secrets, credentials, learner data, or protected answer bodies appear in output.
Repeated findings correlate without losing evidence lineage.
Arcade findings remain distinguishable from educational findings.
Human review remains the final authority.
